candidate.title: TruSeq™ Stranded RNA
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina TruSeq™ Stranded RNA product-preparation schematic only: random-primed RNA/mRNA-to-cDNA conversion, dUTP-marked second-strand synthesis, grouped end preparation, indexed adaptor ligation, and strand-selective amplification to a cluster-ready DNA library. The RNA drawings and the productive/blocked strand outcomes belong to this one workflow; no alternative named method or kit revision is specified. This is a schematic architecture, not a complete experimental protocol.

states.label: RNA/mRNA template
features: Purple RNA is drawn with 5′/3′ orientation; an adjacent RNA drawing carries an AAAAA tail.
RNA/mRNA is the stated input. The figure does not depict a poly(A)-selection or other RNA-enrichment operation.

evidence.locator: Top row: purple RNA/mRNA drawings, 5′ and 3′ labels, AAAAA tail; blue Random primer

states.label: First-strand cDNA paired with RNA
features: A blue cDNA strand is drawn beside the purple RNA template after random priming.
This is an RNA-derived DNA copy; no uracil marking is shown on this first cDNA strand.

evidence.locator: First downward arrow and Create cDNA row: RNA/cDNA pair, cDNA label, dTTP + dCTP + dATP + dGTP

states.label: Double-stranded cDNA with a uracil-marked sense strand
features: The upper blue first cDNA strand is paired with a lower purple strand labeled Sense strand.
Repeated U symbols mark the newly made sense strand; the second-strand reagent label uses dUTP rather than first-strand dTTP.

evidence.locator: Create second strand cDNA row: dUTP + dCTP + dATP + dGTP; U-marked lower Sense strand

states.label: End-repaired, phosphorylated, A-overhanging double-stranded cDNA
features: Phosphate symbols occur at the upper-left and lower-right ends; A overhangs occur at the opposing upper-right and lower-left ends.
The U-marked lower sense strand remains part of the duplex.

evidence.locator: End repair / Phosphorylate / A-overhang row: phosphate symbols at upper-left and lower-right; A at upper-right and lower-left

states.label: Adaptor-ligated cDNA with indexed forked ends
features: Forked adaptors are attached to both ends of the cDNA insert.
P5, P7, Index 1 and Index 2 are labeled on the adaptor arms.
The U-marked sense strand is retained before denaturation/amplification.

evidence.locator: Adaptor ligation row: forked adaptors, P5/P7 and Index 1/Index 2 labels; U-marked lower Sense strand retained

states.label: Indexed DNA library ready for cluster generation
features: The final product is drawn as P5—Index 2—blue insert—Index 1—P7.
The upper route in Denature and amplify shows a paired product; the final simplified drawing carries the same blue insert.
The physical readout carrier is an RNA-derived DNA insert flanked by indexed Illumina adaptor sequences; cluster generation and sequencing are downstream interfaces, not depicted operations.

evidence.locator: Denature and amplify row: upper paired product and lower U-containing Sense strand with short extension and Block polymerase label
Bottom arrow and Product ready for cluster generation row: P5—Index 2—blue insert—Index 1—P7

states.label: Uracil-containing sense-strand route with polymerase blocked
features: The lower route in Denature and amplify retains U symbols and the Sense strand label; it is a blocked strand outcome within this stage, not a separately collected fraction.
A short extension at its right end is accompanied by Block polymerase; no completed library is drawn on this route.

evidence.locator: Denature and amplify row: upper paired product and lower U-containing Sense strand with short extension and Block polymerase label

operations.label: Create cDNA
operations.description: Random priming of the RNA/mRNA input creates the blue first cDNA strand, drawn paired with its purple RNA template. Random primer is an added initiation component, not a separate target workflow.
operations.mechanism: The figure shows a blue random primer and labels the first-strand nucleotide supply dTTP + dCTP + dATP + dGTP. It does not name an enzyme.
operations.information_effect: RNA sequence is represented by a complementary DNA copy that becomes the blue insert carried through the productive route.

operations.label: Create second strand cDNA
operations.description: The first-cDNA-containing intermediate becomes a cDNA duplex. Its newly synthesized lower sense strand contains U marks, while the blue first cDNA strand is retained.
operations.mechanism: The second-strand nucleotide label is dUTP + dCTP + dATP + dGTP, and U symbols appear in the new strand. RNA removal chemistry is not depicted.
operations.information_effect: The two cDNA strands acquire an asymmetric chemical mark: only the depicted second, sense strand is uracil-marked.

operations.label: End repair / Phosphorylate / A-overhang
operations.description: The cDNA duplex receives the grouped end preparation shown by the caption: repaired ends, phosphate symbols at one end of each strand, and A overhangs at the opposite ends. The uracil-marked sense strand is retained.
operations.information_effect: The RNA-derived insert and strand mark remain in a duplex whose ends are prepared for the next depicted adaptor-ligation step.

evidence.locator: End repair / Phosphorylate / A-overhang row: phosphate symbols at upper-left and lower-right; A at upper-right and lower-left

operations.label: Adaptor ligation
operations.description: Forked adaptors are ligated to both ends of the prepared cDNA duplex, adding the depicted P5/P7 and Index 1/Index 2 segments around the RNA-derived insert.
operations.mechanism: End-attached, forked adaptor structures replace the exposed prepared-end drawing. Specific adaptor sequences and ligase identity are not supplied.
operations.information_effect: The insert becomes physically linked to index-bearing adaptor sequences and the P5/P7 interface used in the final cluster-ready product. No cell barcode or UMI is shown.

evidence.locator: Adaptor ligation row: forked adaptors, P5/P7 and Index 1/Index 2 labels; U-marked lower Sense strand retained
Bottom arrow and Product ready for cluster generation row: P5—Index 2—blue insert—Index 1—P7

operations.label: Denature and amplify
operations.description: The adaptor-ligated duplex is denatured and amplified in the single depicted stage. The upper, blue-insert route produces the completed library; the lower U-containing sense-strand route shows a short extension with Block polymerase. These are strand-dependent outcomes of the same incoming duplex, not separately supplied assays or pooled samples.
operations.mechanism: Selective amplification is depicted by productive copying on the upper route and polymerase blockade on the U-marked lower route. The figure does not identify the polymerase or depict uracil excision.
operations.information_effect: The differential fate of the chemically distinguished strands retains a relationship between the final DNA insert and the original RNA strand. The DNA library can support RNA sequence and strand-of-origin interpretation; the diagram supplies no read-number/orientation convention or quantitative counting model.
